_comment: Toy brain-alignment distillation pilot. Teacher gpt2-medium -> student gpt2. Two arms (baseline lambda_brain=0 vs brain lambda_brain>0) at matched budget; report unique_r2 (encoding R^2 after nuisance subtraction) on a contiguous held-out eval block. See scripts/README.md and docs/03-methodology.md.
_sentences_note: Hybrid path: real Pereira 2018 stimulus sentences (downloaded from OSF crwz7, no login) paired with synthetic fMRI. Set backend=pereira + data_dir to swap in the real neural responses, which align row-for-row to these sentences.
